clause_evidence.reasoning: All samples presented ask learners to estimate or evaluate estimated differences between pairs of numbers. Every item directly addresses this requirement through varied formats including fill-in-blank cloze, multiple-choice selection, true-or-false judgment, and error-detection with peer names.

Every rendered sample contains exactly two numbers presented in a subtraction relationship: a minuend and a subtrahend. No item introduces only one number or more than two operands. The requirement is uniformly satisfied across all thirty samples.

All numbers appearing in the sample set have one to four digits. The smallest operands are two-digit values such as ten and ninety. The largest operands are four-digit values such as nine thousand four hundred and thirteen. No number exceeds the four-digit ceiling specified in the requirement.
